channel.title: The QUBE Blog
channel.description: Plain-English reads on training, recovery and the research behind what goes in your glass.

item.title: Electrolytes for athletes: what the research says
item.description: Sweat sodium loss varies widely. What reviews say about rehydrating after practice, drinking to thirst, and magnesium for athletes.

item.title: Creatine and beta-alanine together: does it work?
item.description: What a 2025 systematic review and the ISSN say about taking creatine and beta-alanine together, and where the evidence stops.

item.title: Tart cherry for muscle soreness: what studies show
item.description: Does tart cherry help muscle soreness? Two meta-analyses agree on strength recovery but split on soreness. Here is what athletes should know.

item.title: Creatine for athletes: what the research shows
item.description: What creatine monohydrate does in muscle, what the International Society of Sports Nutrition concluded, and what is still unproven for recovery.
